body.statement: Wendong et al. (2023), Theorem 4.2, obtains componentwise identification from one perfect stochastic intervention per node in CauCA with the causal graph and intervention targets fixed across candidate models.

source.verbatim_statement: The graph G is assumed to be known. Further, we assume that the intervention targets τ_k are observed. We say (G, F, P_G) has known intervention targets if all its elements share the same G and (τ_k)_{k∈⟦0,K⟧}. Theorem 4.2(ii): Suppose for each node i in [d], there is one perfect stochastic intervention that satisfies Asm. 4.1. Then CauCA in (G, F, P_G) is identifiable up to S_scaling.

attestation.note: Main verified the primary NeurIPS 2023 PDF at Definition 3.2, Theorem 4.2(ii), and Appendix E.2 on 2026-09-06; transcription combines the exact scope and theorem sentences with notation normalized from PDF extraction.
